You can calculate your loan-to-value ratio using the [Bankrate LTV Calculator](https://www.bankrate.com/mortgages/ltv-loan-to-value-ratio-calculator/) to see your current home equity and refinancing options.[[1]](https://www.bankrate.com/mortgages/ltv-loan-to-value-ratio-calculator/)

### How LTV Works

Loan-to-Value (LTV) is a percentage that compares your loan amount to the appraised value of an asset, like a house or car. Lenders use it to measure financial risk.[[1]](https://www.rategenius.com/car-loan-to-value-ltv-calculator/)[[2]](https://www.ajdesigner.com/loan-to-value/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/S5c3Wzfl34Y)

- **The Formula**: `LTV = (Loan Amount ÷ Property Value) × 100` [[1]](https://www.ajdesigner.com/loan-to-value/)
- **Example** : If you borrow $160,000 to buy a home worth $200,000, your LTV is 80%.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/7ZuYkFF713g)
- **Why it matters** : A lower LTV means you have more equity and better access to lower interest rates. An LTV above 80% on a conventional mortgage usually requires Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI).[[1]](https://www.mortgagecalculator.org/calcs/ltv.php)[[2]](https://www.bankrate.com/mortgages/ltv-loan-to-value-ratio-calculator/)[[3]](https://www.ajdesigner.com/loan-to-value/)

### Online Calculators

- **Mortgages** : Use the [Mortgage Calculator LTV Tool](https://www.mortgagecalculator.org/calcs/ltv.php) for PMI and refinancing limits.[[1]](https://www.mortgagecalculator.org/calcs/ltv.php)
- **Car Loans** : Check vehicle ratios with the [RateGenius Car LTV Calculator](https://www.rategenius.com/car-loan-to-value-ltv-calculator/).[[1]](https://www.rategenius.com/car-loan-to-value-ltv-calculator/)
- **General Finance** : Try the [Omni LTV Calculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com/finance/ltv) to solve for purchase price, loan size, or down payment.[[1]](https://www.omnicalculator.com/finance/ltv)

If you'd like, tell me:

- What **type of loan** you are looking at (home, car, or commercial)
- Your **loan amount** and the **asset's value** 

I can calculate your exact LTV ratio for you right now.
